exact_target: For positive injective contraction T with injective I-T, r>0, Q=T[rI+(1-r)T]^-1 and bounded R satisfying TR=RQ, prove U_t(T) R=exp(i t log r) R U_t(T). Specialize to scalarTomitaResolvent P and homogeneousRightGNS(matrixUnitRightData P N i j), r=localEigenvalue P N i j; also commute with the existing regular right group.

declarations.name: scaledResolventDenominator
declarations.statement: def scaledResolventDenominator (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (r : ℝ) : H →L[ℂ] H

declarations.name: scaledResolventDenominator_sub
declarations.statement:
theorem scaledResolventDenominator_sub (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (r : ℝ) :

declarations.statement:
theorem scaledResolventDenominator_alt (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (r : ℝ) :

declarations.statement:
theorem scaledResolventDenominator_positive (T : H →L[ℂ] H)

declarations.name: ring_inverse_commutes_of_unit
declarations.statement:

declarations.name: scaledPositiveResolvent
declarations.statement: def scaledPositiveResolvent (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (r : ℝ) : H →L[ℂ] H

declarations.name: scaledPositiveResolvent_nonneg
declarations.statement:
theorem scaledPositiveResolvent_nonneg (T : H →L[ℂ] H)

declarations.name: scaledPositiveResolvent_complement
declarations.statement:
theorem scaledPositiveResolvent_complement (T : H →L[ℂ] H)
    (hT : 0 ≤ T) (h1 : T ≤ 1) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) :
    1-scaledPositiveResolvent T r =
      r • ((1-T) * Ring.inverse (scaledResolventDenominator T r))

declarations.name: scaledPositiveResolvent_le_one
declarations.statement:
theorem scaledPositiveResolvent_le_one (T : H →L[ℂ] H)

    scaledPositiveResolvent T r ≤ 1

declarations.name: matrixUnit_resolvent_denominator_identity
declarations.statement:
theorem matrixUnit_resolvent_denominator_identity (P : SiteProfile) (N : ℕ)
    (i j : chainIdx N) :
    scalarTomitaResolvent P * homogeneousRightGNS (matrixUnitRightData P N i j) *
      scaledResolventDenominator (scalarTomitaResolvent P) (localEigenvalue P N i j) =
    homogeneousRightGNS (matrixUnitRightData P N i j) * scalarTomitaResolvent P

declarations.name: matrixUnit_resolvent_right_scaling
declarations.statement:
theorem matrixUnit_resolvent_right_scaling (P : SiteProfile) (N : ℕ)
    (i j : chainIdx N) :
    scalarTomitaResolvent P * homogeneousRightGNS (matrixUnitRightData P N i j) =
      homogeneousRightGNS (matrixUnitRightData P N i j) *
        scaledPositiveResolvent (scalarTomitaResolvent P) (localEigenvalue P N i j)

declarations.name: scalarTomitaResolvent_regular_right_commutes

declarations.name: scalarTomitaPositiveRoot_regular_right_commutes
declarations.statement:

declarations.name: scalarRegularRight_rootDomain_iff
declarations.statement:
theorem scalarRegularRight_rootDomain_iff (P : SiteProfile) (t : ℝ)

declarations.name: scalarTomitaPolarFactor_regular_right

theorem scalarTomitaPolarFactor_regular_right (P : SiteProfile) (t : ℝ)

    scalarTomitaPolarFactor P (regularRightGNS P t z) =
      scalarGNSRepresentation P (star (regularRightCoreElement P t))

declarations.statement:
theorem scalarTomitaPolar_conjugate_regular_right (P : SiteProfile) (t : ℝ) :
    antiunitaryConjugate (scalarTomitaPolarFactor P) (regularRightGNS P t) =
      scalarGNSRepresentation P (star (regularRightCoreElement P t))

declarations.name: scalarTomitaPolarFactor_regular_left
declarations.statement:
theorem scalarTomitaPolarFactor_regular_left (P : SiteProfile) (t : ℝ)
    (z : ScalarGNSHilbert P) :
    scalarTomitaPolarFactor P
      (scalarGNSRepresentation P (star (regularRightCoreElement P t)) z) =
        regularRightGNS P t (scalarTomitaPolarFactor P z)

declarations.name: resolventDamping
declarations.statement: def resolventDamping (x : ℝ) : ℝ

declarations.name: resolventPhaseFunction
declarations.statement: def resolventPhaseFunction (t x : ℝ) : ℂ

declarations.name: resolventPhaseFunction_norm
declarations.statement:
theorem resolventPhaseFunction_norm (t x : ℝ) :
    ‖resolventPhaseFunction t x‖ = ‖resolventDamping x‖

declarations.name: resolventPhaseFunction_zero_time
declarations.statement:
theorem resolventPhaseFunction_zero_time (x : ℝ) :
    resolventPhaseFunction 0 x = (resolventDamping x : ℂ)

declarations.name: resolventPhaseFunction_add
declarations.statement:
theorem resolventPhaseFunction_add (s t x : ℝ) :
    resolventPhaseFunction s x * resolventPhaseFunction t x =
      (resolventDamping x : ℂ) * resolventPhaseFunction (s+t) x

declarations.name: resolventPhaseFunction_star
declarations.statement:
theorem resolventPhaseFunction_star (t x : ℝ) :
    star (resolventPhaseFunction t x) = resolventPhaseFunction (-t) x

declarations.name: resolventPhaseFunction_gram
declarations.statement:
theorem resolventPhaseFunction_gram (t x : ℝ) :
    star (resolventPhaseFunction t x) * resolventPhaseFunction t x =
      ((resolventDamping x)^2 : ℝ)

declarations.name: resolventDampingOperator
declarations.statement: def resolventDampingOperator (T : H →L[ℂ] H) : H →L[ℂ] H

declarations.name: resolventPhaseOperator
declarations.statement: def resolventPhaseOperator (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (t : ℝ) : H →L[ℂ] H

declarations.name: resolventDampingOperator_cfc
declarations.statement:
theorem resolventDampingOperator_cfc (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsSelfAdjoint T) :
    cfc (fun z : ℂ => (resolventDamping z.re : ℂ)) T = resolventDampingOperator T

declarations.name: resolventDampingOperator_nonneg
declarations.statement:
theorem resolventDampingOperator_nonneg (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (h1 : T ≤ 1) :
    0 ≤ resolventDampingOperator T

declarations.name: resolventPhaseOperator_zero
declarations.statement:
theorem resolventPhaseOperator_zero (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsSelfAdjoint T) :
    resolventPhaseOperator T 0 = resolventDampingOperator T

declarations.name: resolventPhaseOperator_star
declarations.statement:
theorem resolventPhaseOperator_star (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (t : ℝ) :
    star (resolventPhaseOperator T t) = resolventPhaseOperator T (-t)

declarations.name: resolventPhaseOperator_mul
declarations.statement:
theorem resolventPhaseOperator_mul (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsSelfAdjoint T) (s t : ℝ) :
    resolventPhaseOperator T s * resolventPhaseOperator T t =
      resolventDampingOperator T * resolventPhaseOperator T (s+t)

declarations.name: resolventPhaseOperator_gram
declarations.statement:
theorem resolventPhaseOperator_gram (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsSelfAdjoint T) (t : ℝ) :
    star (resolventPhaseOperator T t) * resolventPhaseOperator T t =
      resolventDampingOperator T * resolventDampingOperator T

declarations.name: resolventPhaseOperator_modulus
declarations.statement:
theorem resolventPhaseOperator_modulus (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (h1 : T ≤ 1) (t : ℝ) :
    boundedMapModulus (resolventPhaseOperator T t) = resolventDampingOperator T

declarations.name: resolventPhaseOperator_norm
declarations.statement:
theorem resolventPhaseOperator_norm (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (h1 : T ≤ 1)
    (t : ℝ) (x : H) : ‖resolventPhaseOperator T t x‖ = ‖resolventDampingOperator T x‖

declarations.statement: def resolventImaginaryPower (t : ℝ) : H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H

declarations.name: resolventImaginaryPower_damping
declarations.statement:
theorem resolventImaginaryPower_damping (t : ℝ) (x : H) :
    resolventImaginaryPower T hT h1 hi hj t (resolventDampingOperator T x)=
      resolventPhaseOperator T t x

declarations.name: resolventImaginaryPower_zero
declarations.statement:
theorem resolventImaginaryPower_zero (x : H) :
    resolventImaginaryPower T hT h1 hi hj 0 x = x

declarations.name: resolventPhaseOperator_commutes_damping
declarations.statement:
theorem resolventPhaseOperator_commutes_damping (t : ℝ) :
    Commute (resolventPhaseOperator T t) (resolventDampingOperator T)

declarations.name: resolventImaginaryPower_commutes_damping
declarations.statement:
theorem resolventImaginaryPower_commutes_damping (t : ℝ) (x : H) :
    resolventImaginaryPower T hT h1 hi hj t (resolventDampingOperator T x) =
      resolventDampingOperator T (resolventImaginaryPower T hT h1 hi hj t x)

declarations.name: resolventImaginaryPower_add
declarations.statement:
theorem resolventImaginaryPower_add (s t : ℝ) (x : H) :
    resolventImaginaryPower T hT h1 hi hj s
        (resolventImaginaryPower T hT h1 hi hj t x) =
      resolventImaginaryPower T hT h1 hi hj (s+t) x

declarations.name: scalarTomitaResolvent_complement_injective
declarations.statement:
theorem scalarTomitaResolvent_complement_injective :

declarations.name: scalarTomitaImaginaryPower
declarations.statement: def scalarTomitaImaginaryPower (t : ℝ) : ScalarGNSHilbert P ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] ScalarGNSHilbert P

declarations.name: scalarTomitaImaginaryPower_damping
declarations.statement:
theorem scalarTomitaImaginaryPower_damping (t : ℝ) (x : ScalarGNSHilbert P) :
    scalarTomitaImaginaryPower P t (resolventDampingOperator (scalarTomitaResolvent P) x)=
      resolventPhaseOperator (scalarTomitaResolvent P) t x

declarations.name: scalarTomitaImaginaryPower_unique
declarations.statement:
theorem scalarTomitaImaginaryPower_unique (t : ℝ)
    (U : ScalarGNSHilbert P →L[ℂ] ScalarGNSHilbert P)
    (hU : ∀ x, U (resolventDampingOperator (scalarTomitaResolvent P) x)=
      resolventPhaseOperator (scalarTomitaResolvent P) t x) (x : ScalarGNSHilbert P) :
    U x=scalarTomitaImaginaryPower P t x

declarations.name: scalarTomitaImaginaryPower_zero
declarations.statement:
theorem scalarTomitaImaginaryPower_zero (x : ScalarGNSHilbert P) :
    scalarTomitaImaginaryPower P 0 x=x

declarations.name: scalarTomitaImaginaryPower_add
declarations.statement:
theorem scalarTomitaImaginaryPower_add (s t : ℝ) (x : ScalarGNSHilbert P) :
    scalarTomitaImaginaryPower P s (scalarTomitaImaginaryPower P t x)=
      scalarTomitaImaginaryPower P (s+t) x

declarations.name: scalarTomitaImaginaryPower_strongly_continuous
declarations.statement:
theorem scalarTomitaImaginaryPower_strongly_continuous (x : ScalarGNSHilbert P) :
    Continuous (fun t : ℝ => scalarTomitaImaginaryPower P t x)

declarations.name: scalarTomitaImaginaryPower_inverse
declarations.statement:
theorem scalarTomitaImaginaryPower_inverse (t : ℝ) (x : ScalarGNSHilbert P) :
    scalarTomitaImaginaryPower P (-t) (scalarTomitaImaginaryPower P t x)=x
